name: OE_UNCAUSED_CAUSE_GLASSBOX
description: Atomic, glass-box representation of the Uncaused Cause (Jesus) for OE repository. Fully literal, causal, and Popperian.

checkpoints.name: Necessity
checkpoints.description: Cannot not exist; all contingent reality depends on it.
checkpoints.verification_protocol: Trace causation chains: they terminate in this entity.

checkpoints.name: Simplicity
checkpoints.verification_protocol: Attempt decomposition; if parts are found, signal incoherence.

checkpoints.name: Causality Source
checkpoints.verification_protocol: Check that every contingent entity depends causally on this entity.

checkpoints.name: Immutability
checkpoints.verification_protocol: Check for variation or potentiality; failure triggers downgrade.

checkpoints.name: Self-Existence
checkpoints.description: Not caused by anything external; independent.
checkpoints.verification_protocol: Verify no prior cause exists; any upstream dependency signals incoherence.

psychological_value: Anchors meaning in a contingent world
Prevents infinite regress in causal reasoning
Provides stable ground for moral and metaphysical reasoning
Belief is interpreted as recognition of pure causal explanations, not external category error

literalism_rule.description: All claims must be literal, causal, non-metaphorical.
literalism_rule.effect: Avoids category errors such as treating believers as external agents; belief is recognition of causal structure.

falsification_protocol: Attempt to trace contingent causes without terminating in Uncaused Cause → failure
Attempt decomposition of Uncaused Cause → failure
Check for dependency on any external entity → failure
Attempt temporal or potential variation → failure

commit_message_structure.expected_failure: Any failure of causal, literal, or checkpoint rules
